sentences.en: PAM: Hi Jun.
sentences.zh: PAM: 嗨，Jun。

sentences.en: As you know, I've asked you here today to discuss the future of our Self-Access Centre.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我今天请你来，是为了讨论我们自主学习中心的未来。

sentences.en: We have to decide what we want to do about this very important resource for our English language students.
sentences.zh: 我们必须就这一对英语学习者而言极为重要的资源做出决定。

sentences.en: So, can you tell me what the students think about this?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能告诉我学生们对此是怎么看的吗？

sentences.en: JUN: Well, from the students' point of view, we would like to keep it.
sentences.zh: JUN: 嗯，从学生的角度来看，我们希望保留它。

sentences.en: The majority of students say that they enjoy using it because it provides a variation on the classroom routine and they see it as a pretty major component of their course, but we would like to see some improvements to the equipment, particularly the computers; there aren't enough for one each at the moment and we always have to share.
sentences.zh: 大多数学生表示，他们很喜欢使用自主学习中心，因为它为课堂常规提供了变化，而且他们认为这是课程中相当重要的一部分；但我们希望对设备，尤其是电脑，进行一些改进——目前电脑数量不足，无法做到人手一台，我们总是不得不共用。

sentences.en: PAM: Well yes, the teachers agree that it is a very valuable resource but one thing we have noticed is that a lot of the students are using it to check their personal emails.
sentences.zh: PAM: 是的，老师们也一致认为这是一个非常宝贵的资源；但有一点我们注意到：许多学生正用它来查看个人邮件。

sentences.en: We don't want to stop you students using it, but we think the computers should be used as a learning resource, not for emails.
sentences.zh: 我们并不想禁止学生使用它，但我们认为电脑应当作为学习资源使用，而不是用于收发邮件。

sentences.en: Some of us also think that we could benefit a lot more by relocating the Self-Access Centre to the main University library building.
sentences.zh: 我们中还有一些人认为，若将自主学习中心迁至大学主图书馆大楼内，我们会获益更多。

sentences.en: How do you think the students would feel about that, Jun?
sentences.zh: Jun，你觉得学生们会对这个方案作何感想？

sentences.en: JUN: Well, the library is big enough to incorporate the Self-Access Centre, but it wouldn't be like a class activity anymore.
sentences.zh: JUN: 嗯，图书馆空间足够容纳自主学习中心，但它将不再像现在这样是一种课堂活动了。

sentences.en: Our main worry would be not being www.TopSage.com able to go to a teacher for advice.
sentences.zh: 我们主要担心的是无法随时向老师寻求建议。

sentences.en: I'm sure there would be plenty of things to do but we really need teachers to help us choose the best activities.
sentences.zh: 我相信那里肯定会有大量可做的事情，但我们确实需要老师帮助我们挑选最合适的活动。

sentences.en: PAM: Well, there would still be a teacher present and he or she would guide the activities of the students, we wouldn't just leave them to get on with it.
sentences.zh: PAM: 嗯，届时仍会安排一名教师在场，他或她将指导学生的各项活动，我们不会只是把学生放那儿让他们自行学习。

sentences.en: JUN: Yes, but I think the students would be much happier keeping the existing set-up; they really like going to the Self-Access Centre with their teacher and staying together as a group to do activities.
sentences.zh: JUN: 是的，但我认为学生会更乐意维持现有的设置；他们真的很喜欢和老师一起前往自主学习中心，并以小组形式共同开展活动。

sentences.en: If we could just improve the resources and facilities, think it would be fine.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能仅对现有资源和设施加以改善，我觉得就完全没问题了。

sentences.en: Is the cost going to be a problem?
sentences.zh: 费用会成为问题吗？

sentences.en: PAM.
sentences.zh: PAM。

sentences.en: It's not so much the expense that I'm worried about, and we've certainly got room to do it, but it's the problem of timetabling a teacher to be in there outside class hours.
sentences.zh: 令我担忧的倒不是开支本身——我们当然有足够的预算来实施，而是如何在课余时间安排教师值班的问题。

sentences.en: If we're going to spend a lot of money on equipment and resources, we really need to make sure that everything is looked after properly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们投入大量资金购置设备和资源，就必须确保一切都能得到妥善管理。

sentences.en: Anyway, let's make some notes to see just what needs doing to improve the Centre.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们先做些笔记，明确一下究竟需要做哪些改进来提升该中心。

sentences.en: PAM: Now, what about the computers?
sentences.zh: PAM: 那么，关于电脑呢？

sentences.en: I think it might be a good idea to install some new models.
sentences.zh: 我认为安装一批新型号或许是个不错的主意。

sentences.en: They would take up a lot a less room and so that would increase the work space for text books and so on.
sentences.zh: 新电脑占地更少，从而可以扩大教科书等资料的摆放空间。

sentences.en: JUN: That would be great.
sentences.zh: JUN: 那太好了。

sentences.en: It is a bit cramped in there at times.
sentences.zh: 有时里面确实有点拥挤。

sentences.en: PAM: What about other resources?
sentences.zh: PAM: 其他资源方面呢？

sentences.en: Do you have a list of things that the students would like to see improved?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有一份学生希望改进的物品清单？

sentences.en: JUN: Yes, one of the comments that students frequently make is that they find it difficult to find materials that are appropriate for their level, especially reading resources, so I think we need to label them more clearly.
sentences.zh: JUN: 有。学生经常提到的一点是，他们很难找到适合自己水平的学习材料，尤其是阅读类资源；因此我认为我们需要对材料进行更清晰的分级标注。

sentences.en: PAM.
sentences.zh: PAM。

sentences.en: Well that's easy enough, we can get that organised very quickly.
sentences.zh: 这很容易办到，我们可以很快落实。

sentences.en: In fact think we should review all of the study resources as some of them are looking a bit out-of-date.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为我们还应全面审核所有学习资源，因为其中一些已略显过时。

sentences.en: JUN: Definitely.
sentences.zh: JUN: 没错。

sentences.en: The CD section especially needs to be more current. think we should get some of the ones that go with our latest course books and also make multiple copies.
sentences.zh: CD区尤其需要更新。我们应该采购一些与最新版教材配套的CD，并制作多份副本。

sentences.en: PAM: Good, now I was also thinking about some different materials that we haven't got in there at all.
sentences.zh: PAM: 很好。另外，我还在考虑引入一些目前中心里完全没有的新类型材料。

sentences.en: What do you think of the idea of introducing some workbooks?
sentences.zh: 你觉得引入练习册这个想法如何？

sentences.en: If we break them up into separate pages and laminate them, they'd be a great resource.
sentences.zh: 如果我们将它们拆分成单页并覆膜，就会成为一种极佳的学习资源。

sentences.en: The students could study the main course book in class and then do follow-up practice in the Self-Access Centre.
sentences.zh: 学生可以在课堂上学习主教材，然后在自主学习中心完成后续练习。

sentences.en: JUN: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: JUN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: PAM: Okay, now finally we need to think about how the room iS used.
sentences.zh: PAM: 好的，最后，我们还需要思考一下房间的使用方式。

sentences.en: I'll have to talk to the teachers and make sure we can all reach some agreement on a timetable to supervise the centre after class.
sentences.zh: 我得和老师们谈一谈，确保我们能在课后中心监管的时间安排上达成一致。

sentences.en: But we also need to think about security, too.
sentences.zh: 但我们还得考虑安全问题。

sentences.en: Especially if we're going to invest in some new equipment.
sentences.zh: 尤其是如果我们打算投资购置一些新设备的话。

sentences.en: JUN: What about putting in an alarm?
sentences.zh: JUN: 装个报警系统怎么样？

sentences.en: PAM: Good idea.
sentences.zh: PAM: 好主意。

sentences.en: The other thing I'd like to do is talk to our technicians and see whether we could somehow limit the access to email.
sentences.zh: 我还想做的另一件事是和我们的技术人员沟通一下，看看能否以某种方式限制电子邮件的使用权限。

sentences.en: I really don't want to see that resource misused.
sentences.zh: 我真不希望看到这种资源被滥用。

sentences.en: JUN: What about if we agree to only use it before and after class?
sentences.zh: JUN: 如果我们约定只在课前和课后使用电子邮件，怎么样？

sentences.en: PAM: Yes, that would be fine.
sentences.zh: PAM: 是的，这样可以。

sentences.en: OK, anyway ... that's great for now.
sentences.zh: 好的，总之……目前来看这很棒。

sentences.en: We'll discuss it further when we've managed to ...
sentences.zh: 等我们设法……之后，我们再进一步讨论。

sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿
